title: Technical context. A growing QA toolkit.
description: My engineering foundation supports a transition into manual testing, test design, API validation, and defect investigation.

sections.title: Testing focus
paragraphs: I’m developing a structured approach to testing: identify goals, map rules, select representative inputs, and record reproducible observations.
items: Positive, negative, boundary, and state-transition scenarios
API permissions and persisted data validation

sections.title: Engineering foundation from my CV
items: Git, Docker, Linux, n8n, AWS, DigitalOcean

sections.title: How that helps a QA team
paragraphs: Knowing how a form becomes an API request helps me investigate whether a failure begins in validation, transport, business logic, or persistence. Understanding workflows helps me identify transitions that should be allowed and those that must be rejected.
